help_admin_labour_body: On the Strings page you also set the labour per racket and the own-string fee. Every stringer gets the same labour; members see string prices with labour included, and own-string jobs cost labour plus the fee, which goes to the club. Both are added to a job when it's marked done, so changing them doesn't touch finished jobs.

onboarding_welcome_body: This is where you hand in your racket for restringing — members who string take on the job. In a minute you'll know how it works.
onboarding_welcome_point_request: How to request a restring and drop off your racket
onboarding_welcome_point_rackets: Optional: how to save and manage your rackets
onboarding_request_body: A request is one short form. You don't need to add a racket first.
onboarding_request_step_open: Tap “{action}” on the overview — or the plus at the top of the bar, which is on every page.
onboarding_request_step_racket: Pick your racket — or skip it if you haven't added one yet.
onboarding_request_step_string: Choose a string from the club's catalogue or say which one you're bringing. Add the tension in kg if you know it — your racket's usual tension is filled in for you.
onboarding_request_step_token: Pick the number of a free carabiner — you'll clip it to your racket.
onboarding_request_step_submit: Add a note for the stringer if you like, then tap “{action}”.
onboarding_handover_body: Leave your racket in the clubhouse. The status always tells you how far along it is:
onboarding_handover_body_token: Clip the carabiner with your number to the racket and leave it in the clubhouse. The status always tells you how far along it is:
onboarding_status_requested: Your request is waiting for a stringer to take it on.
onboarding_status_accepted: A stringer has taken it on and is stringing your racket.
onboarding_status_done: Done — your racket is ready to pick up in the clubhouse.
onboarding_status_collected: Picked up. You mark this yourself, or the stringer does when handing it over.
onboarding_handover_track: All your requests are under “{page}”. Until your racket is done you can also cancel a request there.
onboarding_offer_body: You're ready to request a restring. If you have rackets strung often, it's worth saving them — then you just pick one on the form and can see when each was last strung. Shall we show you how?
onboarding_rackets_point_add: A name is enough, e.g. “blue Pure Drive” — it's how you'll recognise it on the form.
onboarding_rackets_point_details: Add brand, model, head size, string pattern and grip size if you like, and change them any time.
onboarding_rackets_point_history: Each racket shows when and with what it was strung.
onboarding_rackets_point_archive: Archive a racket you no longer play — its history is kept. Deleting is only possible while it has never been strung.
help_intro: Everything you can do in the app — tailored to your roles:
help_request_intro: Hand in your racket for restringing — members who string take on the job.
help_request_new_body: Tap “{action}” on the overview or the plus in the header. You don't need to add a racket first — without one, the request simply goes ahead without.
help_request_string_body: Pick a string from the club's catalogue (with its price) or say which string you're bringing. The tension in kg is optional: it's prefilled from the racket, and if you leave it empty the stringer chooses. Leave the crosses empty to string them as tight as the mains. “{notes}” takes anything else.
help_request_token_body: Pick the number of a free carabiner on the form and clip it to your racket — that's how the stringer knows whose it is. Numbers in use are greyed out; yours is free again after pickup.
help_request_dropoff_body: Leave your racket in the clubhouse. Once the request says “{status}”, collect it there.
help_request_status_body: “{page}” lists every request with its status and history. Once done, it also shows what was actually strung and what it costs.
help_request_cancel_body: Until your racket is done you can withdraw the request with “{action}” on its detail page.
help_request_collect_body: Once you've taken the racket, tap “{action}” on the detail page. If the stringer hands it to you, they'll do it.
help_rackets_intro: Optional, but handy if you have rackets strung often: saved rackets are just picked on the form.
help_rackets_add_body: A name is enough, e.g. “blue Pure Drive”. Add brand, model, head size, string pattern and grip size under “{action}”.
help_rackets_edit_body: Tap a racket to change its details. Below them you'll see when and with what it was strung through the app.
help_rackets_archive_body: Archive a racket you no longer play — its history stays, and “{action}” brings it back any time. Deleting removes it from your list for good, while past requests keep showing it. Neither works while a request for the racket is still open.
help_account_intro: Small things that make life easier.
help_account_language_body: The language switch in the header toggles between German and English. Your choice follows you to every device you sign in on.
help_account_tour_body: Restart the short tour from your first visit any time — with “{action}” in the header or on the overview.
help_queue_intro: As a stringer you work through the members' requests.
help_queue_list_body: The queue shows open requests; “{mine}” only the ones you've picked up, “{all}” finished ones too. Click a column header to sort; the search box filters by racket, member or stringer.
help_queue_list_token_body: The carabiner column shows the number on the racket, so you can find it in the clubhouse.
help_queue_accept_body: “{accept}” makes the job yours — the member sees it's being strung. If you can't get to it after all, “{release}” frees it for someone else.
help_queue_complete_body: “{action}” asks what was actually strung: string and tension are prefilled from the request — correct them if you had to use something else. The string price comes from the catalogue; labour and, for an own string, the own-string fee are the club's flat prices. The member sees your notes.
help_queue_handover_body: When you hand the racket back in person, mark the request with “{action}” — the member can also do it themselves.
help_invites_intro: Accounts can only be created with an invite link.
help_invites_create_body: “{action}” makes a link for you to pass on. It works for a single account and expires after the time you choose (24 hours by default).
help_invites_approval_body: Whoever signs up through the link waits until an admin approves the account — only then can they use the app.
help_invites_revoke_body: The list shows which links are still active, used or expired. “{action}” invalidates a link nobody has used yet.
help_billing_intro: What each restring cost, and whether it's been paid.
help_billing_overview_body: Every restrung racket with string, labour and total price and its payment state. Sorting and search work as in the queue.
help_billing_paid_body: Once a member has paid, set the finished job to paid with “{paid}”; “{reset}” undoes it. It doesn't change the request's status.
help_payouts_intro: The labour on paid jobs is owed to the stringers.
help_payouts_balance_body: For each stringer: earned (labour from paid jobs), already paid out, and still outstanding.
help_payouts_reimburse_body: “{action}” records a payout, partial amounts included — the app won't accept more than is outstanding. Each payout shows in the history with its date and who recorded it.
help_training_intro: Weekly plans for group training: who plays when, with whom, and with which coach.
help_training_roster_body: Add trainees with a ball colour (red, orange, green, yellow) and a strength from 0 to 5, plus the trainers. They don't need an account of their own. Anyone no longer taking part is archived and stays visible in old plans.
help_training_availability_body: On a person's page, enter when they can make it each week: drag across the grid to mark (dragging over marked cells erases) or to the minute in the form below. Which hours the grid shows is set at the top of the training section.
help_training_solve_body: Under Plans, set group size, allowed strength spread, session length, start grid and number of courts. The app forms groups of one ball colour, at times when the trainer and every child are free.
help_training_results_body: Each plan shows the week as a timetable and as a list, plus who didn't get a place and why. Every run is saved, so you can compare variants and delete the ones you don't need.
help_admin_intro: Members, roles, and what the club offers.
help_admin_approve_body: New accounts wait for you under Members: “{approve}” opens the app to them, “{reject}” signs them out at once.
help_admin_roles_body: Everyone is a member. On top you can grant {operator} (queue, invites), {controller} (payments, payouts) and {coach} (training planner); {admin} includes everything. You can't give up your own admin role, and the club always keeps at least one admin.
help_admin_strings_body: Under Strings you keep what the club offers: name, gauge, price and order on the form. A string that has been used is deactivated rather than deleted, so old requests still name it.
help_admin_tokens_body: On the same page you set how many numbered carabiners there are. The count can't go below the highest number currently in use.
